about.title: About
about.descrption: The app does not claim to replace the standard or be the final authority. Its purpose is to facilitate understanding of the standard.

formatPreviewer.cardTitle: There is format data in different representations and some additonal information.
formatPreviewer.inputFieldWithLabel: <0>Decimal</0> input values and computed results are handled by JavaScript. Numeric conversions between representations are performed according to <1>the ECMAScript specification</1> and use <2>IEEE 754-2019</2> for floating-point formats and rounding rules, so value classification, numeric types, and rounding behavior depend on how the standard’s rules are implemented.

theme.title: Theme settings
theme.btnLightTitle: Light theme mode (User theme mode source)
theme.btnDarkTitle: Dark theme mode (User theme mode source)
theme.sourceInfoLabel: A source manipulating the theme mode.
theme.modeInfoLabel: When the source is set to User, the theme mode is controlled by the user. When the source is set to System, the theme mode is taken from the device’s system setting. If it can’t be retrieved, Dark mode is used.
theme.schemeInfoLabel: For each theme mode, you can choose its own color scheme from the available list.

toggleEndianness.infoLabel: Toggle current number <0>endianness</0>. By default is used system endianness.
